findings.evidence: `exists_le_minimal` proves both bounds inline as `fun _ hW _ hx ↦ mem_sInfOfIsChain_iff.mp hx _ hW` and `mem_sInfOfIsChain_iff.mpr fun _ hW ↦ hcs hW hx`. Mathlib's ValuationSubring.lean has no `InfSet`/lattice instance that supplies these (grep for InfSet|CompleteLattice|IsChain: no matches).
findings.fix: Add `sInfOfIsChain_le (hW : W ∈ c) : sInfOfIsChain c hc ≤ W` and `le_sInfOfIsChain_iff : V ≤ sInfOfIsChain c hc ↔ ∀ W ∈ c, V ≤ W`. Mark `mem_sInfOfIsChain_iff` `@[simp]` and use the new lemmas in `exists_le_minimal`.
findings.issue: `sInfOfIsChain` has no lemmas saying it is a lower bound of the chain and the greatest one, so consumers (already `exists_le_minimal`) must unfold membership to get them. The characteristic lemma `mem_sInfOfIsChain_iff` (line 86) is not `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: `comapResidue_mapResidue` already needs this step and writes it as `mem_mapResidue_iff.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩`. The existential with a dependent proof binder is not usable as a simp normal form.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] residue_mem_mapResidue (hb : b ∈ B) : residue A ⟨b, hBA hb⟩ ∈ A.mapResidue hBA` and `@[simp] mapResidue_self : A.mapResidue le_rfl = ⊤` (provable via `comapResidue_injective`).
findings.issue: `mapResidue` has only the existential `mem_mapResidue_iff`, which is not `@[simp]`. There is no simp lemma for `residue A ⟨b, hBA hb⟩ ∈ A.mapResidue hBA` when `b ∈ B`, unlike `@[simp] coe_mem_comapResidue_iff` on the comap side. There is also no counterpart to `comapResidue_top`.

summary: The composite/order-isomorphism API is complete, but `sInfOfIsChain` lacks its lower-bound API and simp membership lemma. `mapResidue` lacks a simp lemma for putting a residue into it and a counterpart to `comapResidue_top`.
